import importlib.machinery,json,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from brownie.network.middlewares import caching
assert any(caching.__file__.endswith(suffix) for suffix in importlib.machinery.EXTENSION_SUFFIXES),caching.__file__
base=Path('/reports/brownie-owner-tests')
base.mkdir()
source=Path('/opt/validation/brownie-source')
shutil.copytree(source/'tests',base/'tests')
for name in ['pyproject.toml','setup.cfg','pytest_patched.py']:
    shutil.copyfile(source/name,base/name)
config=base/'pytest.ini'
config.write_text('[pytest]\ntestpaths = tests/network/rpc/test_bytecode_memory.py\naddopts = -p no:pytest_ethereum -p no:pytest-brownie --junitxml=/reports/pytest.xml\n')
Path('/reports/brownie-compiled.json').write_text(json.dumps({'caching':caching.__file__})+'\n')
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'pytest_patched.py'],cwd=base)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
